==Description==
'''XP Boost''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that boosts {{Exp|}} gained by 50% on every map between Friday and Sunday.

==Effects==
When active, '''XP Boost''' will increase {{Exp|}} by 50%. This only applies to matches, it cannot increase rewards from other sources, such as [[Quests]]. Uniquely, this boost is not additive with other modifiers. It is only additive with the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. Because of this, if upon triumphing you would receive {{Exp|100}}, the '''XP Boost''' and [[VIP Boost]] modifiers together would increase it to {{Exp|175}}, though the '''XP Boost''' and the [[Mutation]] modifier would increase it to {{Exp|240}}. This is caused by the former being calculated as ''{{Exp|100}} × (1.5 + 1.25)'', while the latter is calculated as ''{{Exp|100}} × 1.5 × 1.2''.

==Trivia==
*This effect existed in the game before the 8th of March 2024, however, it was not a modifier.
